features.title: INDOOR PLANT POT COVER
features.text: The plant pot can be used to decorate potted house planter, beautify your favorite plants. The natural woven cotton texture is healthy and does not hurt the environment. Plus it adds a modern flair to your house.

summary.text: Customers find the plant pot to be of good quality and appreciate its appearance, with one noting it makes plants look Instagram-worthy. The shape receives mixed feedback - while some find it good size, others report it doesn't retain its shape. The thin plastic material and poor plastic liner inside are concerns, and while some praise the waterproof lining, others report leakage issues. Value for money opinions are divided between those who consider it a great value and those who find it overpriced.
